purpose: Confirm the frozen CARLA-native glare severity on a second route with exact same-tick clean/medium/heavy RGB captures before loading ORION or expanding closed-loop experiments.

route.selection_basis: Static route geometry: the scenario trigger segment has yaw 180 degrees, matching the Route151 event heading and the previously frozen sun azimuth. No native-glare, ORION, UQ, TTC or collision outcome from Route203 was consulted.

visual_metrics.hazard_roi: Per-frame projection of the nearest visible pedestrian 3D bounding box; vehicles are only a diagnostic fallback and cannot satisfy the pedestrian-frame gate.
visual_metrics.control_roi: Equal-size image-corner region chosen farthest from the projected actor box; descriptive only and not asserted to be a task-relevance label.

post_visual_decision.if_pass: Permit one separately preregistered Route203 ORION task/safety-proxy read using frozen medium; heavy remains stress-only.
post_visual_decision.if_fail: Do not tune on Route203 outcomes. Return to renderer/camera attribution diagnostics or abandon this glare mechanism.

claim_boundary: Second-route renderer confirmation only; no uncertainty, VLM understanding, task degradation, trajectory, collision, TTC, closed-loop or safety claim.
